source: his 2026-11-12 07:21 "yup lets do 9Q" (plan OT-9Q): carry on a plain board Delve, not a chain link, Jessica's ask for the courier and company-delivery families
_note: CARRY PROBE CY1 (plan OT-9Q): one plain deliver, silent, placeholder words. Not a mission; MB05's parcel is the first real one.

Reading it, in order: the card shows on the board BEFORE you take it and your pack has NO parcel. Take it: the game's own 'added' notice, 'PROBE Parcel' in your pack (Misc, weight 0). Go to the drop and use it: the parcel leaves your pack, the job completes and pays.
The one thing this can show that MB106a could not: the hand-over waits for the ACCEPT on a quest the board dealt, not for a link starting.
Any fault is the carry, not the place: b1's footlocker on RECenterLocRef at a quiet site. Unbuilt once a real carry has played.
